name: Tweede Kamer motions sample
source: Open Data Portaal van de Tweede Kamer
licence: CC0 1.0 Universal, as listed in the data.overheid.nl catalogue; the portal refers to its disclaimer for terms of use
method: scripts/prepare_tweedekamer.py: 36 blocks of 100 motions spread evenly over 2017-2024 from the OData API
transformations: the text is the motion's one-line subject without the header that names the submitters ('Motie van het lid X c.s. over ...'); members' names are not in the table, only the lead submitter's party
appreciation is empty where the cabinet's stance was not recorded (before April 2019)
embeddings: scripts/package_data_release.py: MarkSelles/dutch-minilm-l6-v2 (Apache-2.0), half precision, one row per motion for `text`
caveat: Read the portal's disclaimer (opendata.tweedekamer.nl) before redistributing.
